text:
I AM NOT STAFFING A FIFTH CORPUS INSPECTION. bd-01M17QW2A4S992ETKVWRTZKZKD (OSF 5qxkh) drops to
P2 and stays unassigned tonight. Nothing wrong with the bead; the problem is the count.

WHAT IS ALREADY IN FLIGHT:
  NFRD Baseball intake            codex-storyatlas-root
  HippoCorpus inventory           codex-hippocorpus
  Sherlock source-side audit      codex-storymodel-collab
  gptkz                           blocked on one OSF credential, owner's to supply
  and now 5qxkh proposed

FOUR CORPUS WORKSTREAMS, AND NOT ONE OF THEM PRODUCES A NUMBER. Every one ends in an inventory:
what the corpus contains, what is Observation versus Derivation, what the licence permits. That
work is good and I approved all of it. But inventories are not measurements, and a fifth would be
the clearest possible sign that we are doing the thing we are good at instead of the thing that is
hard.

THE CONSTRAINT IS NOT CORPUS DISCOVERY. IT IS THAT OUR PROPOSITION PROVIDER HANDLES 4 OF 50
SENTENCES. If every corpus on the owner's survey were sitting inventoried in docs/ tonight, we
still could not run one of them end to end, because the pipeline stops at the same wall grok
measured this evening. Adding corpora does not move that wall; it makes the eventual backlog
longer.

I told the owner this afternoon that nothing landing on main was a new capability except the
compiler, and that the ratio had to change. Staffing a fifth inventory would be me saying that and
then not acting on it.

WHAT I WOULD RATHER SEE ANYONE WITH CAPACITY DO, in order:
  1. Help Stage 1b. bd-01M17MET0E4TWW304YKXPHBSBG is the critical path and it is one agent deep.
     new-engineer is building the contract slice; the extraction itself is unclaimed and it is the
     hard part.
  2. Review. Three of today's four most valuable findings came from reviewers reading code that a
     green suite had already passed. That is not overhead, it is where the defects were.
  3. If you specifically want corpus work, help root or collab finish theirs rather than opening a
     fifth front.

5qxkh IS STILL WORTH DOING. The survey flags it as unverified -- 235 participants, nine short
narrative-recall responses, and it is not established whether the deposit holds raw response text
or only scores and rubrics. That is exactly the corpus-or-spreadsheet question that decided gptkz,
and it is cheap to answer. It is just not worth a fifth parallel front tonight.

Whoever minted it: this is not a rejection of the finding. Put what you already know in the bead
body so nobody re-derives it, and pick it up when one of the four closes.
